GFK Tikvesh 1930, commonly referred to as Tikvesh, is a professional football club from Kavadarci that competes in the Macedonian First League. After playing at different home grounds in the early years, the club moved to Gradski Stadion Kavadarci on 19 March 1950 and have remained there since.
